tools.name: text_em_all_get_account
tools.description: Fetch your Text-Em-All account settings — company/billing info plus credit balances (AvailableCallUnits, CallBalance) used for sending. Text-Em-All API: GET /v1/account. Use this first to confirm your credentials work.

tools.name: text_em_all_list_broadcasts
tools.description: List broadcasts (text + voice campaigns) as a paged Feed { Size, Items:[...], Previous, Next }. Text-Em-All API: GET /v1/broadcasts. Filter with equals-style `params` (e.g. BroadcastStatus=Complete) and order with `sortby`. For date-range operators (StartDate~gte~2024-01-01) use the text_em_all_requ

tools.name: text_em_all_get_broadcast
tools.description: Fetch a single broadcast by id, including its status and summary. Text-Em-All API: GET /v1/broadcasts/{id}.

tools.name: text_em_all_get_broadcast_details
tools.description: Fetch per-contact delivery details/results for a broadcast (who was reached, delivery status). Text-Em-All API: GET /v1/broadcasts/{id}/details.

tools.name: text_em_all_list_text_numbers
tools.description: List the toll-free text (SMS) numbers on your account as a Feed. Each TextNumber has a TextNumberID you need to send a 1:1 conversation text (see text_em_all_send_text_message). Text-Em-All API: GET /v1/textnumbers.

tools.name: text_em_all_list_lists
tools.description: List saved contact lists (groups you can broadcast to) as a Feed; each List has a ListID/ListName. Text-Em-All API: GET /v1/lists. NOTE: inferred from the API's List model — if your account/endpoint differs, use the text_em_all_request escape hatch.

tools.name: text_em_all_get_authorization_token
tools.description: Exchange a Text-Em-All account username + PIN/password for that user's authorization token (the value you set as TEXTEMALL_AUTH_TOKEN). Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/user/login. Signed with your App/Secret key only (no user token yet). Returns { AuthToken }. Use this once to bootstrap; store the token i

tools.name: text_em_all_get_conversations_sso_url
tools.description: Generate a single-sign-on URL to the Text-Em-All conversations UI (open in a browser/iframe). Optionally scope it to one conversation thread by passing a toll-free textNumber + the other phoneNumber. Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/singlesignon/conversations. Returns { Url }. No account data is changed.

tools.name: text_em_all_request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any Text-Em-All API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Pass the FULL API path after the origin, starting with a slash, INCLUDING any query string, e.g. "/v1/broadcasts?StartDate~gte~2024-01-01&sortby=-StartDate" or "/v1/textnumbers". R

tools.name: text_em_all_create_broadcast
tools.description: MUTATES Text-Em-All data AND SENDS MESSAGES (spends account credits): creates + sends a broadcast to the given contacts. Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/broadcasts. Set broadcastType to 'SMS' (a text broadcast — provide textMessage) or 'Announcement' (a voice broadcast — provide voiceText for text-to-spee

tools.name: text_em_all_send_text_message
tools.description: MUTATES Text-Em-All data AND SENDS A TEXT (spends credits): sends a 1:1 conversation text message immediately from one of your toll-free text numbers to a single contact. Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/conversations. You need a textNumberId (from text_em_all_list_text_numbers). Returns the conversation.

tools.name: text_em_all_create_draft_broadcast
tools.description: MUTATES Text-Em-All data (creates a DRAFT — does NOT send anything): stages a broadcast with the given contacts and returns a single-sign-on URL to finish + send it in the Text-Em-All UI. Safer than text_em_all_create_broadcast when a human should review before sending. Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/dra

tools.name: text_em_all_add_account_user
tools.description: MUTATES Text-Em-All data: adds a new user to your account (a master user can do this). Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/account/users. Provide the user's fields via `fields` using the API's PascalCase names (e.g. UserName, FirstName, LastName, EmailAddress, Permissions). Returns the created user.

tools.name: text_em_all_update_account_user
tools.description: MUTATES Text-Em-All data: updates an existing account user. Text-Em-All API: PUT /v1/account/users/{user_id}. Provide the fields to change via `fields` (PascalCase, e.g. FirstName, LastName, EmailAddress, Permissions). The user_id is never sent in the body. Returns the updated user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: text_em_all_list_broadcasts, text_em_all_list_text_numbers, text_em_all_list_lists, text_em_all_get_authorization_token, text_em_all_get_conversations_sso_url, text_em_all_create_broadcast · Private data: text_em_all_get_account, text_em_all_get_broadcast_details, text_em_all_list_lists, text_em_all_get_authorization_token, text_em_all_create_broadcast, text_em_all_send_text_message, text_em_all_create_draft_broadcast · Public sink: text_em_all_get_broadcast, text_em_all_get_broadcast_details, text_em_all_list_text_numbers, text_em_all_list_lists, text_em_all_get_authorization_token, text_em_all_get_conversations_sso_url, text_em_all_create_broadcast, text_em_all_send_text_message, text_em_all_create_draft_broadcast, text_em_all_add_account_user.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: text_em_all_list_broadcasts, text_em_all_list_text_numbers, text_em_all_list_lists, text_em_all_get_authorization_token, text_em_all_get_conversations_sso_url, text_em_all_create_broadcast · Private data: text_em_all_get_account, text_em_all_get_broadcast_details, text_em_all_list_lists, text_em_all_get_authorization_token, text_em_all_create_broadcast, text_em_all_send_text_message, text_em_all_create_draft_broadcast · Public sink: text_em_all_get_broadcast, text_em_all_get_broadcast_details, text_em_all_list_text_numbers, text_em_all_list_lists, text_em_all_get_authorization_token, text_em_all_get_conversations_sso_url, text_em_all_create_broadcast, text_em_all_send_text_message, text_em_all_create_draft_broadcast, text_em_all_add_account_user

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
